cards.abilityText: Hidden / User steals 30% of target enemy Cepter's magic if user possesses less Current Magic than opponent.
cards.flavor: A secret strategy that involves defeating stronger Cepters by ambushing them when they least expect it.
cards.explanation: Hidden = This card is flipped face-down to other Cepters while it is in your hand.

cards.name: Fly
cards.abilityText: User uses 3 dice for their next roll.
cards.flavor: Borrows spirit energy from the upper atmosphere to create wings of light.

cards.name: Foresight
cards.abilityText: User views the top 6 cards in their book, then selects 1 to place in their hand.
cards.flavor: Borrows power from the Supreme Goddess, Culdra to draw a card from the future.

cards.name: Form Portal
cards.abilityText: Teleports user to the nearest gate. (User cannot roll the dice this turn.)
cards.flavor: Forms a dimensional hole in the air that lets Cepters walk directly to the nearest gate.

cards.name: Freeze Cyclone
cards.abilityText: HP-20 to all and creatures.
cards.flavor: Calls an icy storm that freezes fire creatures with frigid winds and shreds earth creatures with razor sharp shards of hail.

cards.name: Gift
cards.abilityText: User gains (User's rank x50)G. / User draws a number of cards equal to their rank from their book.
cards.flavor: A gift from the heavens. It may seem small, but sometimes the smallest gift can mean the difference between life and death.

cards.name: Goblin's Lair
cards.abilityText: Places Goblin on land occupied by user if it is currently vacant. / Recycles to Hand.
cards.flavor: This spell summons not goblins, but a goblin nest. A horrid, smelly place where new goblins are continually spawned.
cards.explanation: Goblin = / ST:20 / HP:30 Recycles = After it is used, the card returns to the user's hand or book (depending on the card).

cards.name: Greed
cards.abilityText: Adds "1.5x Toll" to target creature. (This creature's toll fees are multiplied by 1.5.) / User draws a card.
cards.flavor: By borrowing the power of the god of the gnomes, you will be able to take even more magic from your enemies when they set foot in your territory.

cards.name: Growth Body
cards.abilityText: MHP+10 to target creature (up to a max of 100).
cards.flavor: A spell to strengthen a creature's body. It's so effective, it will last until the creature dies or returns to the card it was summoned from.
cards.explanation: Changes to MHP last until the creature reverts to a card.

cards.name: Haste
cards.abilityText: Adds "Dice 6-8" to target Cepter. (Target Cepter's next two dice rolls yield from 6 to 8.)
cards.flavor: A spell that invokes the spirits of the land to reduce gravity around the target's feet, allowing them to move swiftly.
cards.explanation: This disappears after the Cepter it is on has finished moving.

cards.name: Holy Banishment
cards.abilityText: Returns target creature to its Cepter's hand if the creature's element differs from the territory it inhabits.
cards.flavor: Amplifies the repulsive force between differing elemental energy to eject a creature from its territory if it is a different element from the land.
cards.explanation: If owner's hand has 10 cards in it, this card will be destroyed instead of returning to their hand.

cards.name: Holy Word 1
cards.abilityText: Adds "Dice 1" to target Cepter. (Target Cepter's next dice roll yields a 1.)
cards.flavor: ...It existed before Culdra created the first world...
cards.explanation: This disappears after the Cepter it is on has finished moving.

cards.name: Holy Word 3
cards.abilityText: Adds "Dice 3" to target Cepter. (Target Cepter's next dice roll yields a 3.)
cards.flavor: ...Ultimately, even fate itself could not be foreseen...
cards.explanation: This disappears after the Cepter it is on has finished moving.

cards.name: Holy Word 6
cards.abilityText: Adds "Dice 6" to target Cepter. (Target Cepter's next dice roll yields a 6.)
cards.flavor: ...For Culdcept has surpassed even Culdra, its creator...
cards.explanation: This disappears after the Cepter it is on has finished moving.

cards.name: Holy Word 8
cards.abilityText: Adds "Dice 8" to target Cepter. (Target Cepter's next dice roll yields a 8.)
cards.flavor: ...In the end, it gained the power to twist the very laws of the universe using the power of uncertainty.
cards.explanation: This disappears after the Cepter it is on has finished moving.

cards.name: Home Ground
cards.abilityText: Hidden / If user has 4 or more placed creatures whose element doesn't match the land they're on, the lands will change to match the creatures. / If not, Recycles to book.
cards.flavor: A secret strategy that misleads the enemy by placing creatures on mismatching element lands and then suddenly changing the lands.
cards.explanation: Hidden = This card is flipped face-down to other Cepters while it is in your hand. Recycles = After it is used, the card returns to the user's hand or book (depending on the card).

cards.name: Hyperactive
cards.abilityText: Adds "Vigorous" to target creature. (For 5 rounds, target creature gains the Vigorous ability.)
cards.flavor: Optimizes a creature's body so that it never tires, no matter how much work it is given.
cards.explanation: Vigorous = Is not Fatigued, even after using Secret Arts or Territory Commands.

cards.name: Immobilize
cards.abilityText: Adds "Immobilize" to all creatures. (Cannot be moved by Territory Commands.)
cards.flavor: Petrifies the lower half of each creature's body. They will still be able to attack, but can no longer move.

cards.name: Incineration
cards.abilityText: User gains (number of creatures destroyed thus far x20)G, then the number is reset.
cards.flavor: Burns away the leftover spirits of destroyed creatures, leaving only pure magic behind.
cards.explanation: "Creatures destroyed" only applies to creatures that were destroyed after being placed on a territory.

cards.name: Influence
cards.abilityText: Changes target territory into its owner's most numerous land element.
cards.flavor: Harnesses the greatest type of elemental energy a Cepter possesses to reshape a land into one of that element.

cards.name: Insect Swarm
cards.abilityText: HP-20 to all creatures that are not at maximum HP.
cards.flavor: A cloud of tiny flies whipped into a frenzy by the smell of blood. They will eat away at the flesh of any wounded creature in their path.

cards.name: Joint World
cards.abilityText: Adds "Cross-Element Chains" to world. (For 6 rounds, and territories chain together and and territories chain together.)
cards.flavor: Links the various elemental energies in the world together, causing power to flow together, unhindered by boundaries.

cards.name: Land Drain
cards.abilityText: User steals (number of target's possessed territories x30)G from target enemy Cepter.
cards.flavor: Siphons the magical energy that emanates from enemy territories before it can be collected by its rightful owner.

cards.name: Land Transfer
cards.abilityText: Releases target territory from user's control and reverts it to magic at 70% of its value.
cards.flavor: A spell that releases all the magic binding a territory to the user and then harvests that raw magic.

cards.name: Life Force
cards.abilityText: Adds "Life Force" to target Cepter. (Creature and Item Cards' cost becomes 0G. When this Cepter uses a spell, that spell is neutralized and this vanishes.)
cards.flavor: The universe is founded on a balance of powers. Restricting the power of destruction will lead to an overabundance of creation.

cards.name: Life Stream
cards.abilityText: Fully recovers the HP of all creatures owned by the user.
cards.flavor: Requests aid from the messenger of the god of creation to come and heal the injuries of the user's creatures.

cards.name: Liquid Form
cards.abilityText: Adds "Random Ability Value" to target creature. (In battle, target creature's ST & HP= Random value between 10-70.) / User draws a card.
cards.flavor: Changes a creature's body to a liquid state. Liquefied creatures are in a constant state of flux, resulting in unpredictable strength and durability.

cards.name: Long Line
cards.abilityText: Hidden / If user owns 4 or more territories in a row, user gains 500G. / If not, user draws 2 cards.
cards.flavor: A secret strategy that focuses on adjacent territories over element chains.
cards.explanation: Hidden = This card is flipped face-down to other Cepters while it is in your hand.

cards.name: Magic Bolt
cards.abilityText: HP-20 to target enemy creature.
cards.flavor: Focuses light energy in your fingertips and then fires it at your target.

cards.name: Magical Leap
cards.abilityText: Transports user to any nearby territory of user's choice within 1 to 4 spaces. User cannot roll the dice this turn.
cards.flavor: The ability to leap, even if it's a short distance, to a safe place is most welcome when you find yourself in danger.

cards.name: Magic Shelter
cards.abilityText: Adds "Anti-Spell Wall" to target creature. (Target creature cannot be targeted by spells and will be treated as if it has the Defensive ability.)
cards.flavor: Puts up a barrier that protects from magic, but those the barrier protects are forced to remain stationary.
cards.explanation: Defensive = Cannot invade or be moved with Move Creature.

cards.name: Magma Shift
cards.abilityText: Changes target level 3 or lower territory into a land, or changes target level 3 or lower territory into a land.
cards.flavor: Those who control lava can shape the land as they please.

cards.name: Manna
cards.abilityText: User gains (lap number x50)G.
cards.flavor: A potent energy known to some as the "food of the gods."

cards.name: Mass Growth
cards.abilityText: MHP+5 to all creatures (up to a max of 100). / Synthesis: Items (Changes target to "all creatures owned by the user.")
cards.flavor: Accelerates the growth of creatures, enemy and ally, across the map. If this spell is stabilized with the use of an item, its effect can be aimed at only your creatures.
cards.explanation: Changes to MHP last until the creature reverts to a card. Synthesis = Activate this effect by discarding a specific kind of card.

cards.name: Mass Phantasm
cards.abilityText: Adds "Nullified HP Effects" to all creatures. (HP and MHP cannot be altered by spells.)
cards.flavor: Wraps all creatures in a shimmering veil of illusions, causing magic attacks to miss their mark.

cards.name: Merciful World
cards.abilityText: Adds "Mercy" to world. (For 6 rounds, all Cepters cannot invade territories of Cepters ranked below them.)
cards.flavor: Creates a gentle world where the strong show mercy to the weak.

cards.name: Metal Form
cards.abilityText: Adds "Metallization" to target creature. (Has "Neutralizes: Normal Attacks", but cannot use armor.)
cards.flavor: Transforms a creature's body to metal to protect it from physical attacks.
cards.explanation: Neutralizes = Does not receive damage from opponent during battle.

cards.name: Metamorphosis
cards.abilityText: User selects an item or Spell Card from target enemy Cepter's hand and changes all copies of the selected card in all Cepters' hands and books to Holy Word 6.
cards.flavor: Disrupt the enemy's evil plans and lead them back onto a righteous path.
cards.explanation: Holy Word 6 = Give Dice 6 to target Cepter. Makes the next roll 6.

cards.name: Miracle Call
cards.abilityText: User draws 1 Evo Card from their book. / If an Evo Card can't be drawn, user draws 2 cards instead.
cards.flavor: A call for help in times of crisis. Upon hearing it, the creature you raised with loving care will hurry to your side.

cards.name: Mirror World
cards.abilityText: Adds "Extinction" to world. (For 6 rounds, at Battle Start, if either creature has multiple copies in play, that creature is destroyed.)
cards.flavor: Creates a ruthless world full of evil twins. You never know when yours will find you...

cards.name: Misty World
cards.abilityText: Adds "Anti-Spell" to the world. (For 6 rounds, all Cepters cannot be targeted by spells.)
cards.flavor: A thick fog blankets the world, dampening the power of spells and making it impossible to properly target other Cepters.

cards.name: Natural World
cards.abilityText: Adds "Abilities Disabled" to the world. (For 6 rounds, Secret Art, Upon Defeat, and Battle End abilities do not activate.)
cards.flavor: This spell alters the universe itself and temporarily removes the law of existence required for the cards of Culdcept to fully exert their powers.

cards.name: Obliteration
cards.abilityText: All Cepters lose (number of Element Gems owned x70)G. / If there is no Gem Store, all Cepters lose 10% of their current magic.
cards.flavor: Overloads the elemental energy in all active Element Gems, causing them to detonate and blow away their owners' magic.

cards.name: Outrage
cards.abilityText: Moves target creature to adjacent enemy territory.
cards.flavor: Enrages a creature, causing it to invade nearby territory without thinking.

cards.name: Pacifism
cards.abilityText: Adds "No Invasions" to all Cepters. (For 2 rounds, you cannot invade.)
cards.flavor: Drains the fighting spirit from all Cepters to temporarily prevent any battles. However, this false peace will only last for so long...

cards.name: Peace
cards.abilityText: Adds "Peace" to target creature. (Cannot be invaded, and toll becomes 0G.)
cards.flavor: An enchantment that causes all living things that approach to forget conflict and strife.

cards.name: Penalize
cards.abilityText: Adds "Paralysis" to all Evo Cards. (Can't attack or use items, and abilities do not activate.)
cards.flavor: A penalty issued by Culdra to the swiftly growing dragon tribe, in order to balance the universe.

cards.name: Philosophy
cards.abilityText: If user has a card with the Synthesis ability in hand, draw 3 cards / If not, user draws 2 cards.
cards.flavor: The scholar who developed this technique considers it to be the truth of the world.
cards.explanation: Synthesis = Activate this effect by discarding a specific kind of card.

cards.name: Plague
cards.abilityText: Adds "Poison" to all creatures. (At the end of a battle, the creature's base HP is reduced by half of its MHP.)
cards.flavor: Generates a highly contagious pathogen and spreads it far and wide.

cards.name: Poison Mind
cards.abilityText: User views the top 6 cards in target enemy Cepter's book, then selects 1 to destroy. / User draws a card.
cards.flavor: See into a Cepter's mind, disrupting their thoughts and causing them to drop one of their cards.

cards.name: Prophecy
cards.abilityText: User draws 1 card of a specified type from their book.
cards.flavor: The best prophets are not those who simply tell of future events, but those who change the world for the better to fulfill their prophecies.

cards.name: Purify
cards.abilityText: Removes all effects from the map. User then gains (number of different removed x50)G.
cards.flavor: A spell that reverts all enchantments into the base magic used to cast them.

cards.name: Quicksand
cards.abilityText: Adds "Force Stop" to target creature. (The next Cepter who tries to pass this creature within 2 rounds must stop here.)
cards.flavor: Conjures a field of quicksand around a creature. It sucks in the feet of anyone trying to pass, forcing them to stop.
cards.explanation: "Force Stop" will not activate or be consumed if a Cepter lands directly on this territory.

cards.name: Quietude
cards.abilityText: Adds "Mute" to all Cepters (Spells cannot be used for one round.)
cards.flavor: Though its duration is limited, not being able to cast spells can be fatal for a Cepter.

cards.name: Quintessence
cards.abilityText: Changes a target territory with a level lower than 5 to .
cards.flavor: After years of research, alchemists discovered a fifth element comprised of the other four. This spell infuses a land with the power of this new element.

cards.name: Ray of Law
cards.abilityText: Destroys all cards with a value of 100G and up in all Cepters' hands.
cards.flavor: The power of the God of Creation seals away all cards that would bring ruin to the world.

cards.name: Ray of Purge
cards.abilityText: Destroys all spell cards in all Cepters' hands.
cards.flavor: When the will of the god of creation becomes a light that blankets the world, cards that sow discord will be reduced to ash.

cards.name: Redivision
cards.abilityText: Redistributes all Cepters' magic so that it is spread equally among them.
cards.flavor: Those who have little are filled with want. Those who have much are filled with fear.

cards.name: Reincarnation
cards.abilityText: User discards all cards from current hand and draws a number of cards equal to the number they discarded +1.
cards.flavor: Everyone goes through times when they want to abandon everything and start over. However, doing so isn't always guaranteed to improve the situation...

cards.name: Release
cards.abilityText: Adds "Unlock Limits" to user. (For 4 rounds, ignore item restrictions and land restrictions.)
cards.flavor: For a fleeing window of time, its user is freed from the shackles of impossibility. With greater freedom comes greater possibilities.

cards.name: Relief
cards.abilityText: Exchanges creatures in 2 of user's territories. / Recycles to Book
cards.flavor: Send the right man for the right job.
cards.explanation: Recycles = After it is used, the card returns to the user's hand or book (depending on the card).

cards.name: Remission
cards.abilityText: Target gate will be marked as passed. (Cannot be used on the final gate needed to complete a lap.)
cards.flavor: Draws in magical energy from a distant gate, tricking it into thinking that the user has passed it.

cards.name: Remote Switch
cards.abilityText: Changes the direction of all Path Switches. / Recycles to Book. / If no Path Switch is present, user draws a card.
cards.flavor: A spell that allows Cepters to use telekinesis to remotely change the Path Switch.
cards.explanation: Recycles = After it is used, the card returns to the user's hand or book (depending on the card).

cards.name: Restore
cards.abilityText: Removes Fatigued from target creature. / Fully recovers target creature's HP.
cards.flavor: Heals a creature's injuries and fatigue so they can rejoin the battle immediately.

cards.name: Revival
cards.abilityText: Target Cepter's book is reverted to the state it was in when the game began.
cards.flavor: Culdra's power gathers up all a Cepter's lost, broken, and discarded cards and reforms their book to the state it was in before the battle.

cards.name: Senility
cards.abilityText: Adds "Last Breath" to target creature. (This creature is destroyed at the end of battle.)
cards.flavor: A curse that causes creatures to quickly age, making their bodies frail and their bones brittle.

cards.name: Sense of Wild
cards.abilityText: User draws a card. If the drawn card is a creature, it is summoned to a random vacant land.
cards.flavor: In order to make the most of this spell, a Cepter must sharpen their sixth sense.
cards.explanation: If there are no empty lands, the Creature Card is added to the user's hand.

cards.name: Shatter
cards.abilityText: User selects an Item or Spell Card from target enemy Cepter's hand and destroys it.
cards.flavor: During the war of the gods, the rebellious god was wounded by finely forged weapons and armor. His grudge towards those items still lingers in this card.

cards.name: Shining Geyser
cards.abilityText: HP-30 to target enemy creature. / Synthesis: Spells (Changes effect to "HP-40.")
cards.flavor: Intense light erupts from a territory, dealing huge damage to creatures. Sacrificing another spell to fuel this card's power increases the light's intensity.
cards.explanation: Synthesis = Activate this effect by discarding a specific kind of card.

cards.name: Sigil of Drain
cards.abilityText: Adds "Drain Spell" to target creature with no Secret Art. (Grants "Secret Art (20G): User steals 10% of target enemy Cepter's Current Magic.")
cards.flavor: Places a magic seal on a creature that grants it the use of a drain spell.
cards.explanation: Secret Art = Used as a Spell in the Spell Phase. If this is added to a creature that already has a Secret Art, it will only be able to use its native Secret Art.

cards.name: Sigil of Float
cards.abilityText: Adds "Move Spell" to target creature with no Secret Art. (Grants "Secret Art (50G): Adds "Dice 5" to target Cepter.")
cards.flavor: Places a magic seal on a creature that grants it the use of a floating spell.
cards.explanation: Secret Art = Used as a Spell in the Spell Phase. Dice 5 = Rolls 5 on dice. If this is added to a creature that already has a Secret Art, it will only be able to use its native Secret Art.

cards.name: Sigil of Shrink
cards.abilityText: Adds "Shrink Spell" to target creature with no Secret Art. (Grants "Secret Art (50G): MHP-10 to target creature.")
cards.flavor: Places a magic seal on a creature that grants it the use of a shrinking spell.
cards.explanation: Secret Art = Used as a Spell in the Spell Phase. Changes to MHP last until the creature reverts to a card. If this is added to a creature that already has a Secret Art, it will only be able to use its native Secret Art.

cards.name: Sneak Hand
cards.abilityText: Hidden / User steals an Item Card from the hand of a target enemy Cepter with two or more Item Cards.
cards.flavor: A secret strategy that focuses on taking items from owners who probably won't even notice they're gone...
cards.explanation: Hidden = This card is flipped face-down to other Cepters while it is in your hand.

cards.name: Solid World
cards.abilityText: Adds "Land Protection" to the world. (For 6 rounds, lands cannot have their level lowered and their element cannot be changed by spells.)
cards.flavor: Stretches an invisible barrier over the world. Lands under this barrier's protection cannot be destroyed or transformed by unnatural means.

cards.name: Spartoi
cards.abilityText: Places a Skeleton on a random vacant land.
cards.flavor: An ancient spell cast by planting the teeth of a hydra in the ground. From the teeth, an army of skeletons grows. It's a popular spell among evil wizards.
cards.explanation: Skeleton = / ST:30 / HP:40

cards.name: Speed Penalty
cards.abilityText: User steals (target's lap # - user's lap # x100)G from the enemy with the highest lap number. (If user has highest lap number, no G will be taken.)
cards.flavor: A spell that brings poetic justice down upon Cepters who focus too strongly on making laps.

cards.name: Spirit Walk
cards.abilityText: Adds "Distant Movement" to target creature. (Creature can move to any vacant land.)
cards.flavor: By harnessing the same power as the tree spirit, Dryad, your creatures will be able to instantly reach faraway lands.

cards.name: Squeeze
cards.abilityText: User chooses a card from target Cepter's hand and destroys it. / Target Cepter gains 150G.
cards.flavor: Forcefully extracts the magical energy from a card. Cards that have been drained of their magic crumble into ashes.

cards.name: Steal Gem
cards.abilityText: User steals one random element gem from target enemy Cepter. / If there is no Gem Store, user will steal 80G from target enemy Cepter.
cards.flavor: Summons a magical hand that steals gems from other Cepters.

cards.name: Stone Blast
cards.abilityText: HP-30 to target or creature.
cards.flavor: Cepters debate whether this spell calls a gale full of stones or speeding stones that create a gale. Either way, it's bad news for any air or earth creatures caught in it.

cards.name: Storm Shift
cards.abilityText: Changes target level 3 or lower territory into a land, or changes target level 3 or lower territory into a land.
cards.flavor: Those who control the atmosphere can make the sky and sea do their bidding.

cards.name: Subsidence
cards.abilityText: Lowers level of target enemy Cepter's highest level territory by 1. / Synthesis: Subsidence (Changes target to "all Cepters.").
cards.flavor: Converts magical energy in a territory into gravity to crush the land. Using two of these cards at once causes gravity spikes all over the map.
cards.explanation: Synthesis = Activate this effect by discarding a specific kind of card.

cards.name: Sudden Impact
cards.abilityText: Hidden / Lowers level of target level 4 territory by 1.
cards.flavor: A secret strategy that disrupts the development of an enemy's territory by raising up sharp boulders from below.
cards.explanation: Hidden = This card is flipped face-down to other Cepters while it is in your hand.

cards.name: Temptation
cards.abilityText: Use target creature's Secret Art.
cards.flavor: Beguiles an enemy creature, allowing you to use its skills for yourself.
cards.explanation: Usable even when target creature is Fatigued. No cost needs to be paid for the Secret Art being used as a result of this spell.

cards.name: Theft
cards.abilityText: User chooses a spell card from target enemy Cepter's hand and steals it.
cards.flavor: Blatantly stealing an enemy's spell is a tactic that should only be used as a last resort for a Cepter.

cards.name: Thrust Blow
cards.abilityText: Moves target creature to adjacent vacant territory.
cards.flavor: Disrupts atmospheric pressure to create an intense wind that blows creatures away to a completely different land.

cards.name: Thunderclap
cards.abilityText: Hidden / HP-30 to target creature with summon conditions.
cards.flavor: A secret strategy that surprises the enemy by summoning a bolt of lightning from a clear blue sky.
cards.explanation: Hidden = This card is flipped face-down to other Cepters while it is in your hand.

cards.name: Tiny Army
cards.abilityText: Hidden / If user has 5 or more creatures with MHP of 30 or under, those creatures receive MHP +10 and user gains 500G. / If not, Recycles to Book.
cards.flavor: A secret strategy that utilizes a small army with high morale.
cards.explanation: Hidden = This card is flipped face-down to other Cepters while it is in your hand. Changes to MHP last until the creature reverts to a card. Recycles = After it is used, the card returns to the user's hand or book (depending on the card).

cards.name: Turn to the Wall
cards.abilityText: Transforms target creature into a specific Defensive creature of the same element.
cards.flavor: Overloads a creature's inherent elemental energy, causing it to transform into a concentrated elemental mass.
cards.explanation: Defensive = Cannot invade or be moved with Move Creature. Depending on its element, the targeted creature will change accordingly.

cards.name: Tyranny
cards.abilityText: Adds "Paralysis" to all creatures with MHP of 30 and under. (Creatures cannot attack or use items and their abilities do not activate.)
cards.flavor: When faced with the power of absolute authority, weak creatures are struck with fear and find themselves unable to move.

cards.name: Uniformity
cards.abilityText: Gives "200 Toll" to target Cepter. (For 3 rounds, the toll fee for all of a Cepter's territories become 200G.)
cards.flavor: This spell equalizes all a Cepter's territories. Regardless of how strong or weak a territory is, it will be made the same as the rest.

cards.name: Vitality
cards.abilityText: Adds "Ability +20" to target creature. (In battle, this creature is granted ST & HP+20.) / User draws a card.
cards.flavor: An untapped well of power lies deep in the heart of every living thing. Those who claim to know their limits are merely ignorant of their own potential.

cards.name: Vortex
cards.abilityText: Adds "No Battle Abilities" to target creature. (In battle, effects and abilities besides this one do not activate.) / User draws a card.
cards.flavor: Creates a black vortex in the sky that sucks in everything and reduces it to nothingness. Magic, abilities, light... nothing is safe from oblivion.

cards.name: Waste World
cards.abilityText: Adds "Raise Cost" to the world. (For 6 rounds, cards of rarity require 1.5xG to use, cards of rarity and require 2x G to use.)
cards.flavor: Creates a world where those with nothing are given peace, and those with everything are given suffering.

cards.name: Water Shift
cards.abilityText: Changes target territory belonging to user into a land.
cards.flavor: Amplifies the elemental water energy in the land to the point where it overtakes the other elements, causing the land itself to shift and reform.

cards.name: Wind of Hope
cards.abilityText: User draws 2 cards from their book.
cards.flavor: Summons the messenger of Culdra, the Supreme Goddess to bestow cards upon a weary Cepter.
